api_note: FFmpeg 9.1 via ffmpeg-the-third 6.0: demux/decode/scale/resample/filter are safe wrappers. Manual/unsafe gaps: (1) seek takes RangeBounds, there is no SeekRange::Backward -> used ..=ts which maps to avformat_seek_file(min=MIN, ts, max=ts); (2) buffer source args need the numeric AVPixelFormat, so AVPixelFormat::from(pixel).0 is taken from ffmpeg::ffi; (3) frame data is stride/linesize padded, so RGB24 rows are hashed row-by-row and audio is clamped to samples*channels*4; (4) decoder + resampler need explicit EOF/drain and flush loops; (5) filter graph: buffer/buffersink + the parsed filter are added with the safe Graph::add, but the safe Parser did not connect them (buffer output pad left unconnected), so the three pads are wired with unsafe ffmpeg::ffi::avfilter_link; (6) the safe resampler allocates its output from input.samples() and truncates 44.1k->48k, so the probe allocates the output frame itself.
